name: Thermospheric density calibration (JB2008 temperature corrections)
description: JB2008 thermospheric mass density at points (propagator/hpop's JB2008, driven by SET SOLFSMY/DTCFILE rows as hpop reads them) with an exospheric-temperature correction added to JB2008's DSTDTC: spherical harmonics in latitude and local solar time per time bin, or values at time nodes, optionally linear in altitude. Estimates the correction from observed densities (Gauss-Newton on log-density residuals per bin) or from the orbital decay of catalogued objects (element-set histories propagated by Vallado SGP4; Gauss-Newton on the sets' mean semi-major axes with each object's ballistic coefficient): public, simplified analogues of the Dynamic Calibration of the Atmosphere in HASDM; the orbital energy of states in Earth-fixed axes (the Jacobi integral of the EGM2008 geopotential, with its gradient) and the work done by JB2008 drag along them.

sequentialJustification.detail: Deterministic density evaluation, SGP4 propagation and least squares over caller-supplied points, element sets, drivers and observations. No host calls, threads or network access.
